nodes.summary: Let $d$, $d_h$ and $n_h$ be positive integers. In multi-head attention, a layer maps each hidden state $h_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$ to a query $W^Q h_t$ and a key $W^K h_t$ with $W^Q, W^K \in \mathbb{R}^{d_h n_h \times d}$, and head $i$ uses the $i$-th blocks of $d_h$ coordinates, $q_{t,i} = W^Q_i h_t$ and $k_{t,i} = W^K_i h_t$ with $W^Q_i, W^K_i \in \mathbb{R}^{d_h \times d}$. nodes.summary: DeltaNet is a linear transformer whose matrix-valued state $S_t \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is updated by the delta rule $S_t = S_{t-1} - \beta_t (S_{t-1} k_t - v_t) k_t^{\mathsf{T}} = S_{t-1} (I - \beta_t k_t k_t^{\mathsf{T}}) + \beta_t v_t k_t^{\mathsf{T}}$, with keys and values $k_t, v_t \in \mathbb{R}^d$, writing strength $\beta_t = \sigma(W_{\beta} x_t) \in (0, 1)$ and output $o_t = S_t q_t$. nodes.title: Delta-rule linear attention

nodes.summary: For a frozen pretrained weight matrix $W_0 \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times k}$ and a rank $r$, low-rank adaptation trains $B \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times r}$ and $A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times k}$ and uses the weight $W_0 + BA$: a layer input $x$ gives $h = W_0 x + BAx$. The matrix $A$ is initialised at random and $B$ at zero, so the update $BA$ starts at $0$.
nodes.title: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA)

nodes.summary: Multi-head latent attention, introduced in DeepSeek-V2, computes keys and values from one cached latent vector per token. Let $d$, $n_h$, $d_h$, $d_c$ and $d_c'$ be positive integers and $d_h^R$ a positive even integer.
nodes.title: Multi-head latent attention (MLA)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
